engineering_area_conflict.title: Choose the room for {device}
engineering_area_conflict.description: A room assignment conflict is active for **{device}**. Open the repair to review the current Home Assistant assignment and the Loxone request.

abort.conflict_changed: The room assignment changed while this repair was open. Review the current repair and try again.
abort.entry_unavailable: The Loxone configuration entry is no longer available.
abort.invalid_action: The selected room action is not supported. Open the repair again and choose one of the available actions.
abort.invalid_desired_area: The requested Loxone room is no longer valid. Refresh the engineering inventory before trying again.
abort.invalid_repair: This repair does not match a current Loxone room conflict.
abort.repair_unavailable: The current room conflict could not be loaded. Try again after the integration has refreshed.
abort.resolution_failed: The room decision could not be completed. Review the current repair and try again.
